payload.reason: The evidence provides specific rules and considerations for assigning error categories based on part-of-speech and types of errors.

claims.text: Error categories are assigned based on part-of-speech (POS) tags and the nature of the edit, such as Missing, Unnecessary, or Replacement errors.
The classification of errors also considers types that are not well-characterized by POS, like Spelling or Word Order, using roughly 50 rules.
The framework aims to balance informativeness and practicality, avoiding overly detailed categories that complicate classification.
